title: Which diagonal is compact?
promptMarkdown: On $\ell^2$ consider $A e_n=(-1)^n n^{-1/2}e_n$ and $B e_n=(1+n^{-1})e_n$. Decide compactness of each and compute each spectrum. For every spectral point say whether it is an eigenvalue.
hintLadder: Use diagonal truncation for one operator and a separated image sequence for the other.
A diagonal inverse exists boundedly exactly when the distance to all diagonal entries is positive.
